headerDisplay: Read-only monitoring for EG4 solar and storage systems. Choose which Apple Home accessories you want to expose, even when a subsystem is currently inactive.
footerDisplay: **Security:** The official EG4 Monitor endpoint is used by default. Custom endpoints require explicit opt-in. Plain HTTP is permitted only for explicitly enabled private/loopback hosts. This plugin does not send EG4 control commands.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name for this Homebridge platform.

username.title: EG4 Monitor Username
username.description: Username for the EG4 Monitor account used for read-only monitoring.

password.title: EG4 Monitor Password
password.description: Password for the EG4 Monitor account.

baseUrl.title: EG4 Monitor URL
baseUrl.description: Official EG4 Monitor URL by default. Custom HTTPS endpoints require the option below.

allowCustomEndpoint.title: Allow a custom EG4-compatible endpoint
allowCustomEndpoint.description: Enable only when using another trusted EG4-compatible server, such as an EG4 demo/test site or a locally hosted compatible endpoint.

allowInsecureLocalEndpoint.title: Allow HTTP on a private/local endpoint
allowInsecureLocalEndpoint.description: Advanced. Allows credentials over plain HTTP only to localhost, .local, or RFC1918 private-network addresses. Never enable this for an Internet-hosted server.

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often Homebridge refreshes EG4 data. Minimum 60 seconds.

showBattery.title: Show Battery
showBattery.description: Expose battery state-of-charge, charging/discharging status, power, and energy data when available.

showGrid.title: Show Grid
showGrid.description: Expose utility-grid availability and power data when available.

showSolar.title: Show Solar
showSolar.description: Expose current solar production and energy totals when available.

showLoad.title: Show House Load
showLoad.description: Expose whole-home/load power and energy usage when available.

showGenerator.title: Show Generator
showGenerator.description: Expose generator status. With valid generator telemetry, an unconnected or idle generator can remain visible as Gen OFF.

missingDataBehavior.title: When selected data is unavailable
missingDataBehavior.description: OFF means the plugin has telemetry and knows the subsystem is inactive. N/A means the selected accessory is visible but this system/API does not provide enough telemetry to determine its state.

debugApi.title: API Debug Logging
debugApi.description: Logs endpoint-level diagnostics without response bodies or credentials. Enable only while troubleshooting.

layout.title: EG4 Account & Connection
layout.description: Credentials are used only to connect to the configured EG4-compatible endpoint.

layout.title: Apple Home Accessories
layout.description: Choose the status tiles you want Homebridge to expose. A selected tile may remain visible even when a subsystem is inactive.

layout.title: Endpoint & Advanced Settings
layout.description: Most users should leave these settings unchanged.
